concept: CloudTrail: API call auditing + S3 Object Lock for immutable logs
tests: The combination for recording all API calls (management events) and storing them immutably for audit.
expected: CloudTrail trail → S3 bucket + S3 Object Lock in compliance mode (WORM for the retention period). Triggers: "record all API calls", "management events", "immutably", "compliance auditing".
why_not: VPC Flow Logs — network traffic, not API; GuardDuty — threat detection; CloudWatch Logs subscription filters — alerting, not immutable storage.
